I now think my earlier answer was wrong: the clock most likely did not start when the tenant stopped paying rent in 1986, because a lessee's possession is presumed permissive until he openly repudiates the owner's title in a way the owner can know. The best-supported start date is the 1992 expiration of the seven-year lease, when possession was no longer under any lease term, which would put the 20-year period at 2012, after the Boy Scouts' 2009 discovery. This depends on the jurisdiction's rules on holdover tenants and repudiation, which I haven't verified.

CONFIDENCE: 40
